pages.title: Bubble Pillar
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Bubble Pillar wraps a bubble shooting board around a tower. Rotate the structure to choose an angle, then aim and fire to clear its bubbles. Work out trajectories around the circular surface while exploring the game's different locations.

pages.title: Stickman Warriors Superhero Fight
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Stickman Warriors Superhero Fight combines stick figure battles with character progression. Move around the arena, attack, defend, and use special skills to defeat opponents. Combine dodges and timed strikes while improving your fighter for further encounters.

pages.title: Geometry Overlap
pages.creator: KridaX
pages.description: Geometry Overlap asks you to recreate a target using black geometric pieces on a circle. Drag shapes into place, remembering that overlapping areas cancel each other into white. Adjust their positions until the resulting pattern matches the goal exactly.

pages.title: Fruity Craft Merge
pages.creator: Csharks Games & Solutions Pvt Ltd.
pages.description: Fruity Craft Merge starts with seeds and turns matching items into sprouts, trees, fruit, and prepared dishes. Combine identical pieces to move through the growth stages. Serve or deliver your creations to customers, earn rewards, and expand the collection of fruit recipes.

pages.title: Ninja Survivor
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Ninja Survivor sends a ninja through three dimensional levels filled with traps, zombies, and bosses. Move through the locations, avoid deadly mechanisms, and fight enemies blocking the route. Improve the character, unlock weapons, and select skins as the challenges become tougher.

pages.title: EQ Test Puzzle
pages.creator: Big Wave
pages.description: EQ Test Puzzle combines emotion recognition with picture assembly tasks. Drag pieces into empty slots and rotate them to fit, matching the expression, color, or keyword required by the level. Choose a difficulty and use a hint when you need help.

pages.title: Mojo Emoji
pages.creator: Hyper Rabbit Games
pages.description: Mojo Emoji challenges you to identify a hidden word or phrase from a set of emoji clues. Work out how the pictures connect, then click letters to place them into the answer slots. Solve the expression to continue through the puzzles.

pages.title: Mojicon Love Connect
pages.creator: 2Million Games
pages.description: Mojicon Love Connect uses matching sweet themed tiles to unlock scenes from the animal kingdom. Tap two identical tiles to combine them and work through the board. Complete the matching challenges to discover the next moments in the progression.

pages.title: Chicken Banana Run
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Chicken Banana Run sends its unusual runner through the world and into space. Jump or double jump to keep moving while collecting gold, diamonds, and special items. Cover a longer distance and gather pickups to increase your score.

pages.title: Block Parkour Trials
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Block Parkour Trials challenges you to reach a portal at the end of an obstacle course. Use WASD or the arrow keys to move and jump with Space or the right mouse button. Judge the gaps and landings to continue toward the finish.

pages.title: Paper Doll Diary: Dress Up DIY
pages.creator: Bravestars Games
pages.description: Paper Doll Diary: Dress Up DIY lets you style a paper doll with clothing, accessories, hairstyles, and makeup. Browse the wardrobe and combine pieces into looks of your own. Your fashion choices accompany the doll through the events of her story.

pages.title: Guivo.io
pages.creator: guivo.io
pages.description: Guivo.io turns match three puzzles into two minute multiplayer contests. Swap pieces to score while ice spreads across the board; frozen pieces stay fixed but can still form matches. Clear neighboring matches to break ice for bonus points and outscore your opponent.

pages.title: Block Merge City
pages.creator: Pirus Games
pages.description: Block Merge City has you place buildings on an isometric board and combine at least three identical ones into larger structures. Check the upcoming block queue and plan around the space left. Hammers remove unwanted pieces, but the game ends when no placement remains possible.

pages.title: Celebrity Aesthetic Challenge
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Celebrity Aesthetic Challenge lets you create celebrity inspired outfits for a series of fashion themes. Mix clothing, accessories, and hairstyles for styles ranging from soft girl looks to streetwear and red carpet glamour. Complete each challenge with a coordinated interpretation of its aesthetic.

pages.title: Sprunki Torches Maze
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Sprunki Torches Maze asks you to light every torch in a room to unlock its door. Some torches switch together, so turning one on can change others. Move with the arrow keys, toggle torches with Space, and avoid the bats while finding the exit.

pages.title: Brick Breaker Chipi Chipi Chapa Chapa Cat
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Brick Breaker Chipi Chipi Chapa Chapa Cat has you control the bottom paddle and bounce balls into green bricks. Destroy every green block to finish a level. Catch falling bonuses for additional balls and lives while the dancing characters accompany the action.

pages.title: Data Diggers
pages.creator: Rike Games
pages.description: Data Diggers turns data downloading into a merging business. Select data blocks for your USB drives to download, earn money, and buy more drives. Combine matching USBs to increase their capacity and download speed, then invest in more efficient data collection.

pages.title: Chicken shooter io
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Chicken shooter io puts armed birds into a shooting battle. Choose equipment, move around the battlefield, and use your weapons to eliminate the other characters. Control movement with WASD and handle aiming and attacks with the mouse, or use touch controls.

pages.title: The Earth Evolution
pages.creator: Online Games
pages.description: The Earth Evolution lets you develop a planet by placing buildings and decorative objects. Buildings collect sunlight, which supplies resources for further construction. Choose how to arrange each area and expand your design as your planet produces more resources.

pages.title: Shape-Shifting
pages.creator: Sixcube
pages.description: Shape-Shifting turns changing vehicles into the key to a race. Select a form suited to the terrain ahead so you can travel over each section faster. Keep adapting as the surface changes and try to reach the finish before the other racers.

pages.title: Indian Suv Offroad Simulator
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Indian Suv Offroad Simulator puts you in an SUV on rugged trails. Use the arrow keys to drive across difficult terrain, Space to brake, and C to change the camera. Judge your route as you maneuver the vehicle through the offroad environment.

pages.title: Jewels Kyodai Mahjong
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Jewels Kyodai Mahjong asks you to clear layouts by matching two unblocked tiles with the same symbol. Choose a particular puzzle or use Shuffle mode to explore different arrangements. Make pairs quickly to improve the score awarded when the board is empty.

pages.title: Bus Stop
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: Bus Stop challenges you to collect passengers and drive them to their destinations. Tap to move the bus, then release to bring it to a stop. Work through the routes and continue to new levels as you complete the transport tasks.

pages.title: Air Traffic Control
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Air Traffic Control has you draw landing routes for incoming planes and helicopters. Tap and drag from each aircraft to direct it toward a safe landing zone. Manage the available airspace and land more traffic to unlock additional airport maps.

pages.title: Fashion Holic
pages.creator: Gameloft SE
pages.description: Fashion Holic puts you in charge of outfits for fashion shows, red carpet appearances, and photoshoots. Check the theme of each event and choose clothes to suit it. Combine the wardrobe choices into looks for the different moments of celebrity life.

pages.title: Crazy Office Slap Smash
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Crazy Office Slap Smash sends you through an office slapping the characters in your path. Slide to move and strike, then tap to beat the boss at the end. Watch for thrown balls and hit them back at the attackers.

pages.title: Car Smasher! Upgrade & Customize Hyper Casual Game
pages.creator: Digi Smile limited
pages.description: Car Smasher! lets you choose, customize, and upgrade a car for combat races. Drag left or right to dodge obstacles and ram rival vehicles until they are wrecked. Keep your own car moving through the course while trying to defeat the opposition.

pages.title: Tile Matching
pages.creator: RedFoc
pages.description: Tile Matching asks you to clear available tiles in groups of three identical pictures. Click or tap a tile to move it into the collecting area, then select matching partners. Plan the collection order to remove every tile from the board.

pages.title: Easter Bunny Eggs Jigsaw
pages.creator: Baby Daisy Games
pages.description: Easter Bunny Eggs Jigsaw offers six Easter pictures to assemble from scattered pieces. Select a mode, then drag and drop the fragments into the positions that rebuild the image. Complete the chosen picture before trying another scene or difficulty.

pages.title: Guess Word
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Guess Word gives you six attempts to identify a hidden word. Enter a guess and use the feedback to learn which letters belong in the answer and whether their positions are correct. Type with the keyboard or select the onscreen letters.

pages.title: Crazy Jetpack
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Crazy Jetpack sends a suited flyer down a hazardous runway with a prototype jetpack. Collect coins and bonuses while avoiding missiles, rotating lasers, and spiked boulders. Spend your coins on shop upgrades and try to extend the next flight.

pages.title: Monsters TD 2
pages.creator: Booblyc OU
pages.description: Monsters TD 2 asks you to protect the portal to Earth from waves of strange creatures. Build different towers along the route and use spells to support the defense. Start waves when ready, adjust the action speed, and stop monsters before they reach the entrance.

pages.title: 2 Minutes Soccer
pages.creator: Crimson Games IO
pages.description: 2 Minutes Soccer offers a short soccer match between Argentina and Italy with superpowered players. Move with WASD or the arrow keys, shoot with Z, and pass with X. Switch the controlled player with Space as you work to score and defend.

pages.title: Basket Champ
pages.creator: Freak X Games
pages.description: Basket Champ uses a flipper to knock a bouncing ball toward a basketball hoop. Tap to strike at the right moment and keep the ball from dropping out of play. Complete levels to continue through changing themes and more demanding basket challenges.

pages.title: Swimming Hero
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Swimming Hero has you switch lanes in an indoor pool to keep an endless swim going. Avoid obstacles and collect snorkels for extra speed or shields for protection. React to the next lane opening and try to increase your score.

pages.title: Super Sergeant Zombies
pages.creator: G55.CO
pages.description: Super Sergeant Zombies sends you through levels full of undead enemies in search of an exit. Move with WASD, aim and shoot with the mouse, and change weapons using the mouse wheel. Reload when needed and fight your way toward a route out.

pages.title: Funny Shopping Supermarket
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Funny Shopping Supermarket asks you to help Hippo and friends collect everything on their shopping lists. Find the required products, place them in grocery bags, and visit the cashier to pay. Search departments containing food, clothing, tools, and other goods.

pages.title: Pumpkin Rider
pages.creator: BeedoGames
pages.description: Pumpkin Rider takes motorcycle riding through Halloween courses filled with deadly obstacles. Manage acceleration and braking while rotating the bike to handle the terrain. Reach the marked finish safely using keyboard controls or the onscreen riding buttons.

pages.title: Princess Fashion Quiz
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Princess Fashion Quiz lets you prepare Mia, Bella, Emma, and Ava for a fashion contest. Choose outfits and accessories that show each princess's styling ideas before the event begins. Use the mouse to browse the wardrobe and assemble their looks.

pages.title: Line Driver
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Line Driver challenges you to keep a car on a narrow road as it winds through corners. Control the vehicle with the mouse, collect coins for extra points, and avoid crashing. Stay on the route for as long as you can.

pages.title: Eternal Fury
pages.creator: GAME HOLLYWOOD HONG KONG LIMITED
pages.description: Eternal Fury combines turn based role playing battles with strategy elements. Summon mercenaries of different qualities and develop their attributes to shape your forces. Use the mouse to manage your characters and take part in the game's encounters.

pages.title: Mineblox Memory Challenge
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Mineblox Memory Challenge hides Minecraft themed pictures behind cards. Turn them over and use what you remember to locate identical pairs. Keep matching the revealed pictures until every partner on the board has been found.

pages.title: Learn to Draw Glow Cartoon
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Learn to Draw Glow Cartoon provides guided drawing activities for cartoon and anime pictures. Follow the steps with the mouse or touch controls to build each illustration. Add glowing colors as you work through the selected drawing tutorial.

pages.title: Toilet Paper The Game
pages.creator: Quicksave
pages.description: Toilet Paper The Game traps rolls of toilet paper inside differently shaped objects. Rotate each container to release the rolls and let them tumble out. Work out how to turn the shape so every trapped roll can escape.

pages.title: JoJo Run
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: JoJo Run has you jump through colorful running stages while collecting coins and diamonds. Punch snails and break walls that block the route. Use Space to jump and X to attack, or touch controls, while working toward higher scores and later levels.

pages.title: Super Football Kicking 2020
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Super Football Kicking 2020 challenges you to score free kicks across different stages. Drag the ball with the mouse to adjust the shot's power and send it toward goal. Aim your attempts around the defensive setup to find a scoring route.

pages.title: City Helicopter Simulator Game
pages.creator: hitNrun games
pages.description: City Helicopter Simulator Game puts you in the pilot's seat of a presidential transport helicopter. Carry out flying and parking missions while serving as a Marine One escort pilot. Guide the aircraft through the transport tasks and make the required landings.

pages.title: Friendly Airplanes For Kids Coloring
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Friendly Airplanes For Kids Coloring offers eight aircraft pictures and 23 colors to paint them with. Choose a picture, apply your preferred shades, and work quickly for a better score. Save the finished image after completing your airplane design.

pages.title: Purple Hero Jigsaw
pages.creator: Shunda Inc
pages.description: Purple Hero Jigsaw offers twelve pictures connected to a heroine's mission to save her city. Assemble each jigsaw by fitting the pieces into the full image. Choose an easy, medium, or hard version to set the puzzle's difficulty.

pages.title: Ninja Hero Runner
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Ninja Hero Runner challenges a ninja to survive a dungeon course filled with obstacles. Guide the runner around hazards and collect coins along the route. Keep the attempt going for as long as possible while gathering more of the pickups.

pages.title: Vintage Sports Car Difference
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Vintage Sports Car Difference presents paired pictures of classic sports cars with small changes hidden between them. Compare the scenes and select the seven differences. Find each altered detail to complete the current picture puzzle.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter Bunny
pages.creator: Online Games io
pages.description: Bubble Shooter Bunny asks you to remove colored bubbles by forming matching groups of at least three. Aim with the mouse and fire into the arrangement. Clear every bubble from the screen to finish the level.

pages.title: GunGame shooting warfare blocky gangster
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: GunGame shooting warfare blocky gangster is a shooter set in a block styled world. Use WASD to move, handle aiming and gunfire with the mouse, and switch weapons during combat. Hold Shift to run and press Tab to open the menu.

pages.title: Save The Egg
pages.creator: GameOnHai
pages.description: Save The Egg puts a fragile egg on top of a car traveling over hills. Drive carefully and balance the vehicle so its passenger does not fall off. Cover as much distance as possible using A and D or the onscreen controls.

pages.title: Zombie Mission 4
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Zombie Mission 4 gives two players zombies, traps, and rescue objectives to tackle together. Use the available weapons to clear enemies, free hostages, and collect the data disks. Coordinate movement and attacks to get both characters through the increasingly difficult stages.

pages.title: Red Carpet Dress Up Girls
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Red Carpet Dress Up Girls lets you create event looks from a large collection of clothing. Browse the available outfits and combine pieces for a model or celebrity inspired appearance. Use the mouse to experiment with different fashion combinations.

pages.title: Christmas 2019 Differences 3
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Christmas 2019 Differences 3 asks you to compare two festive pictures and locate every difference before time expires. Select the altered details as you find them, using the Hint button if needed. Faster completion earns a higher score.

pages.title: Bricked
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Bricked challenges you to remove groups of bricks sharing the same color. Plan each selection so the pieces left behind can still be cleared. Three rewind wishes let you undo choices while working toward a higher score.

pages.title: Top Model Dress Up
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Top Model Dress Up lets you style virtual models and celebrities from a collection of fashion choices. Select clothing and combine the pieces into the appearance you want. Use the mouse to try different looks on the doll characters.

pages.title: Mega Truck
pages.creator: Darko Veljovic
pages.description: Mega Truck asks you to haul cargo across a series of obstacle filled roads. Drive with the arrow keys and keep the truck balanced as it climbs over the terrain. Reach each level's goal without losing the load along the way.

pages.title: Zombeat.io
pages.creator: FrenzyFrameStudio
pages.description: Zombeat.io makes color decide which zombies you can eat and which can eat you. Hunt vulnerable rivals to evolve, then change color at barrels when you need a different matchup. Avoid predators while growing your zombie and climbing the leaderboard.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Science Fair
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Baby Hazel Science Fair helps Hazel choose and build a model for her class presentation. Assist with the project, then help the children show their creations to the teacher. Follow the characters' needs as they prepare for the science fair award.

pages.title: Penalty
pages.creator: KidsGames4All
pages.description: Penalty challenges you to score from the penalty spot before losing three balls. Use the mouse or a finger to aim and take each shot. Keep finding the goal to build your total while protecting the attempts you have left.

pages.title: Traffic Stop
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Traffic Stop puts you in charge of traffic signals at a busy crossing. Stop cars to prevent accidents, then let them continue before they wait too long. Use the mouse to change the lights and manage the flow through the intersection.

pages.title: Ninja Run
pages.creator: Aningame
pages.description: Ninja Run sends a ninja running automatically toward the finish. Click or tap to jump over bombs and gather coins along the street. Time each leap around the hazards and use Space or the pause button when you need a break.

pages.title: Uphill Bus Simulator
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Uphill Bus Simulator offers different buses to drive through a series of levels. Use WASD to control the vehicle and Space for the handbrake while managing the uphill routes. Press Tab to pause between attempts at the driving challenges.

pages.title: Military Cars Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Military Cars Puzzle features six pictures of military vehicles to rebuild as jigsaws. Choose a 16, 36, 64, or 100 piece layout and arrange the fragments into the complete image. Try another vehicle picture or increase the piece count for a harder puzzle.

pages.title: Robot Hero City Simulator 3D
pages.creator: CyberGoldfinch
pages.description: Robot Hero City Simulator 3D gives a robot city missions involving combat, flight, and escapes from police or military forces. Use melee weapons, a bazooka, and a jetpack to handle the tasks. Spend upgrades on attributes such as strength, health, speed, and equipment duration.

pages.title: Tap Heli Tap
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Tap Heli Tap challenges you to keep a helicopter flying toward its goal. Use clicks or taps to guide the aircraft around enemies and collect coins along the route. Gather more pickups while staying in flight to improve your score.

pages.title: Stickman Hunter
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Stickman Hunter turns archery into a sequence of stick figure shooting challenges. Aim the bow and launch arrows at the enemies in each stage. Work out the shot direction needed to hit the targets and complete the level.

pages.title: Extreme Airhockey
pages.creator: Gamebuilt.com
pages.description: Extreme Airhockey pits you against a computer opponent at an air hockey table. Use your paddle to send the puck into the opposing goal while protecting your own. Select the difficulty and scoring target to set up the match.

pages.title: Zombie Gunpocalypse
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Zombie Gunpocalypse asks you to eliminate zombies while conserving your ammunition. Aim carefully and look for objects in each scene that can help take out enemies. Use those opportunities to clear the level with fewer direct shots.

pages.title: Orange Ring
pages.creator: Dreamly Games
pages.description: Orange Ring has you guide a ring along a line without letting the two touch. Keep the orange ring balanced around the track as it travels. Maintain the clearance for as long as possible to build a higher score.

pages.title: EG Neon War
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: EG Neon War puts a glowing spaceship against hostile craft and asteroids appearing around the play area. Shoot the threats before they strike and steer clear of meteor storms. Keep surviving and destroying opponents to raise your score.

pages.title: Jump Red Square
pages.creator: T
pages.description: Jump Red Square asks you to launch a red square at a target while a gray block crosses its path. Tap when the route is clear and score by hitting the target. A collision with the moving gray obstacle ends the attempt.

pages.title: Hangman Capitals Cities
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Hangman Capitals Cities asks you to identify world capitals in a hangman puzzle. Choose letters to uncover the hidden city name while avoiding too many wrong guesses. Complete the answer before the hanging figure is finished.

pages.title: Cute Snails Jigsaw
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Cute Snails Jigsaw offers six snail pictures with four piece counts to choose from. Select a 16, 36, 64, or 100 piece puzzle and assemble the image. Fit the fragments together as quickly as you can to complete the selected scene.

pages.title: Princess BFF Floss Dance
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Princess BFF Floss Dance joins Moana as she teaches Elsa and Ariel the floss. Follow her step by step guide to practice the dance with the princesses. Work through the moves and help the friends learn the routine together.

pages.title: Color Swap
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Color Swap asks you to guide a ball through the sections of obstacles matching its current color. Time your jumps around the rotating patterns and check which color you need for the next crossing. Avoid touching the differently colored sections along the route.

pages.title: Dino Jump
pages.creator: Freak X Games
pages.description: Dino Jump has you guide a small dragon across platforms using two jump lengths. Left makes a short leap and Right a longer one, letting you match the gaps ahead. Collect clocks for more time and build your score to unlock other dragons.

pages.title: Fruit Slicer
pages.creator: Red Eye Production
pages.description: Fruit Slicer puts you through fruit cutting challenges in three modes. Slice the pieces onscreen to score points, and try to improve the best result shown after each attempt.

pages.title: Crazy Freekick Game
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Crazy Freekick Game lets you choose a soccer team and attempt free kicks through six levels. Tap to set the ball's direction and send each shot toward goal. The challenges become harder as you work through the stages.

pages.title: Icy Purple Head 2
pages.creator: Miniduck
pages.description: Icy Purple Head 2 asks you to guide a character into a delivery box by switching between sticky purple and slippery icy forms. Hold to turn icy and slide, then release to regain grip. Use platforms, airflow, and other devices while avoiding hazards.

pages.title: Desafio Gamer
pages.creator: Stein Produccion
pages.description: Desafio Gamer puts you through five stages combining survival timers and circle collection. Hold the screen to move right and adjust your position to meet each stage's objective. Later tests change the speed and requirements, with your results determining a performance rank.

pages.title: Catch the dot
pages.creator: Red Eye Production
pages.description: Catch the dot asks you to trap a blue dot before it escapes. Fill empty spots to cut off possible routes and gradually surround it. Choose each blocked position carefully until the dot has no path left to take.

pages.title: Match 3 Classic
pages.creator: Functu
pages.description: Match 3 Classic offers matching puzzles across a series of levels, alongside Timekiller and free play modes. Form groups of three matching pieces and clear combinations from the board. Choose the mode you prefer and work on improving your result.

pages.title: Mahjong Mania
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Mahjong Mania asks you to remove matching pairs from layered tile layouts. Find two identical tiles that are available to select and clear them together. Plan your choices to expose more pieces, using a reshuffle or restart when no matches remain.

pages.title: Princess Fashion Looks
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Princess Fashion Looks lets you create outfits for a princess from a selection of clothing and fashion items. Browse the choices and combine pieces into your preferred appearance. Try alternative combinations to give her a range of different looks.

pages.title: Dress Designer Studio
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Dress Designer Studio asks you to design three dresses for a girl's best friend. Each dress is intended for a different event, giving you another occasion to style. Work through the design choices and create a separate outfit for each gathering.

pages.title: Frankie Stein Labs
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Frankie Stein Labs lets you build a virtual Frankie Stein doll in a secret laboratory. Search for hidden body parts, assemble them, and sew the pieces together so they stay in place. Finish the creation by choosing clothing for the completed character.

pages.title: Dotted Girl Resurrection Emergency
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Dotted Girl Resurrection Emergency is a medical simulation about reviving an injured superhero. Follow the prompted tasks and use the doctor's tools to resuscitate her, then complete the aftercare activities. Tap through the sequence to help her get back on her feet.

pages.title: Ice Kingdom Wardrobe Cleaning
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Ice Kingdom Wardrobe Cleaning asks you to help two sisters reorganize their closets. Gather the clothes they need, sort the outfits, and discard old garments. After cleaning, choose dresses, shoes, and accessories to create a new look for each sister.

pages.title: Descendants Rooftop Party
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Descendants Rooftop Party lets you prepare two friends for an evening gathering above the city. Choose outfits suited to the party and complete their looks with shoes, bags, and jewelry. Coordinate the available fashion pieces so both friends are ready to attend.
